name: Mihta Askiy Data Centre
summary: Proposed gas-powered data centre about 40 km northeast of Peace River in Northern Sunrise County, Alberta. Alberta's project inventory says the plan involves acquiring a partially completed power plant and converting it into a natural-gas-powered data centre. The proponent, Cree Ative Datacenter Corp GP, filed a federal project description for a 650 MW gas plant to serve the data centre, starting with simple-cycle turbines and later converting to combined cycle. The federal agency decided in March 2026 that no further federal assessment was required; Alberta's inventory lists the project as proposed, with work commencing in 2027.
